what: Analog Devices designs high-performance analog and mixed-signal chips that convert real-world signals such as temperature, sound and motion into data, and manage power.
customers: Industrial equipment makers above all, then car, communications and consumer electronics companies.
moat: Hard-to-design, long-lived chips with high margins and tens of thousands of customers.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 17% last year as the industrial chip cycle turned
Gross margin of 61% with thousands of products that stay in production for a decade or more
Analysts see about 24% upside from current levels
watch: Industrial and automotive bookings and factory utilisation.
